notes.title: Patch Notes 1/29/2018
notes.content:
-All lights in the Apartment level can now be turned on and off with switches located in the Apartment rooms and hallways. 
-All lighting in the Apartment has been reworked on this level.
-The walls and the ceiling of the Apartment level have been retextured.
-Faceless movement speed has been dramatically increased.
-Faceless now randomly spawn when the lights are off in the Apartment.  Keep the lights on for safety. 
-Brightness of the lighting in the level after the hospital and in Hell level.
-Fixed footstep audio in Hell level.
-The phone model has been replaced with a different one.
-The game now has automatic difficulty scaling. 
-2 bodies have been removed in the hospital morgue.
-Difficulty has been reduced on the level after the hospital by removing player movement restrictions.

This is the largest update I have introduced to the game since launch.  As a result, there is a big possibility of new bugs to occur.  If you find anything that seems to be not working as intended,  please post in the Discussion thread on Steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes 12/18/2017
notes.content:
-The elevator section of the first level does not get skipped anymore.
-Enemies now follow you onto the elevator.
-Henry AI is now more aggressive.
-Henry's attack animations are sped up by 30%.
-Removed the duplicate input settings in the options menu.



If you find any bugs, please let me know in the discussions section on Steam.
